signal: As a Dynamics 365 commerce solution provider, 365 Smart Shop faces 2026 release-wave demand where global sales ops teams struggle to turn buying signals into rep action fast enough.

email.subject1: a signal play for 365 Smart Shop
email.body1:
James, with the Dynamics 365 Commerce 2026 release wave driving new demand, retail buyers are evaluating fast.

For a global sales ops team, the hard part isn't intent data, it's the latency between a signal and a rep actually touching the account, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for 365 Smart Shop off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
James, quick follow-up for 365 Smart Shop.

Most sales ops teams sit on plenty of intent but lose it to follow-up latency, where a hot account cools before a rep touches it. The lift compounds when every signal triggers a researched, personalized touch automatically instead of waiting in a queue.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I'd change, and our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
James, last bit of proof for 365 Smart Shop.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to similar software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
James, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If tightening signal-to-action latency isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Release-wave season is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a sales ops motion? I'll tailor it to 365 Smart Shop either way.
